judged_rule: judged is "published" where the v3.28 summary publishes a Code quality score, the equal mean of the judges with a valid review (scored_panels); every other row carries the reason it has none. status names the case
no_code_rule: combined_no_code_zero is the combined score with each run that left no code to judge (an empty patch or no source change) counted as 0, as the board counts timeouts; for a judged run it equals combined_33, and the one unreviewable run (max hedgecore) has none
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score; null for a judge with no valid review
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator and its 9 points move to the reviewed score for that submission (intent_recovery_redistributed); 16 published Beam runs needed it
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed

cost_fields.cost_usd: null on every run: Reflection publishes no price for Beam

token_fields.raw_tokens: input (cached included) plus output, summed over Mirror's per-call usage records
token_fields.token_usage.output_tokens: output tokens; Mirror reports no separate reasoning count
token_fields.model_calls: assistant records with usage in Mirror's conversation database
token_fields.failed_model_requests: model requests Mirror logged as failed and carried on from

model_identity: harness-recorded: every inference in Mirror's conversation database names the requested model (Beam-1.0-501B-A23B); Reflection's API also lists it under the alias Beam-501B-A23B
